staff.name: Gretell Diez
staff.description: Founder and lead colorist, specializing in advanced color services, grey blending, and customized transformations. Dedicated to providing high-level consultations and exclusive services, while guiding the salon team to deliver exceptional results.

staff.name: Ledieska Rodriguez
staff.description: Professional hairstylist specializing in blowouts, haircuts, root touch-ups, and hair treatments. Known for her attention to detail, efficiency, and creating beautiful, wearable results. Dedicated to making every client feel comfortable, confident, and happy with their hair.

Staff was very nice and accommodating. I LOVE my nails, Dainet took her time and did an amazingly detailed job.

2/3/26 had an appt at 9:30, walked in and they told me to sit down. At 9:50am the owner came to ask who my appt was with and proceeded to tell me the person left and they didn't have anyone to do nails. I leave on vacation tomorrow and now I'm scrambling to find a person to do my nails. Appt was confirmed and should've been cancelled when the person left. Terrible service.
